title: Teriyaki Marinade
description: A sweet-savory marinade that makes chicken tender, juicy, and full of flavour. Perfect for grilling, baking, or stir-frying.

method.instruction: Combine all ingredients in a bowl until the sugar dissolves.
Reserve half for glazing cooked chicken, and use the remaining half to marinate chicken for 15 minutes up to overnight in the fridge.
Use as a glaze by brushing over chicken during the last minutes of cooking until thick and shiny.
